environment.note: Odoo tenant is SHARED between sim and prod. Every field below reflects the state observed on the shared tenant BEFORE apply.

cloudflare.note: The new SALE_PDF_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN secret was set only on env=sim via `wrangler secret put SALE_PDF_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN --env sim`. To rotate: `wrangler secret put SALE_PDF_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN --env sim` again with a fresh 64-hex value, then update the Server Action's webhook_url via the apply script. To remove: `wrangler secret delete SALE_PDF_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN --env sim`.
